actual_checks: Full official problem, wrapper/meta/source/author records, report and both full prior contributions read. The added arbitrary finite flag PL-sphere nerve family exceeds earlier torus/surface products; no all-PD4 announcement is adopted or universal Singer proof claimed.

For finite flag PL S^(n-1), the Davis complex is contractible cubical with those links, hence torsion-free finite-index quotient is a closed aspherical n-manifold. Theorem 11.1.1 through V(n)=>I(n) yields full Singer conclusion for n=3,4; contractibility alone is not substituted for L2 vanishing.

Abelianization W->(Z2)^v is onto with index 2^v. Every finite subgroup is conjugate into a finite simplex special subgroup on which the map is injective; kernel is torsion-free and acts freely. The explicit commutator cover exists, rather than being assumed.

Orbifold Euler cell stabilizers have order 2^k for k-vertex simplices. Passing to index d multiplies Euler characteristic. In dimension 4, f2=2*f3 and f0-f1+f2-f3=0 give b2=chi=d*(16-5*f0+f1)/16>=0. Missing factor d would be wrong; it is present. Theorem 11.3.2 and scaling give b1=b_(n-1)=0 for every n>=3 in this Coxeter class, without resolving remaining interior degrees.
